description: Deterministic routing rules. Selection is a pure function; every decision logged with chosen_runtime + reason.

edit_code.description: Any task requiring code edits must use a runtime that can safely sandbox and guard the edit.

final_integration_critic.description: The Critic that decides promotion of a candidate wave to work must be able to execute the full test/acceptance suite and read the repo.

state_affecting_result.if_runtime_cannot_return_schema: output MUST be written to inbox/<runtime>/raw/, then normalized by Normalize-RuntimeResult.ps1 and validated against worker_summary.schema.json before any state transition or handoff update.

selection_algorithm: From the set of enabled runtimes that satisfy all required_capabilities for the task AND pass the safety floor for the role/phase, choose the highest in preference_rank. Tie-break: lowest max_parallel cost among candidates, then lexicographic template id. Record chosen_runtime, template_id, instance_id, and full reason in the handoff Runtime Notes and orchestrator.log.
example_decision: Task requires edit_code + local_commit. claude-code satisfies (edit+worktree+scope). local-script does not (no edit_files, no worktree, no enforce_scope). Result: claude-code chosen, reason logged.
notes: Orchestrator implements this logic (or calls a helper). Routing never consults runtime adapters for decision-making; registries are the source of truth.
